context: Asuka and Sakura use a study tool.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: study chat; vocabulary (返信/音声/ツール/教材/ダウン) in natural home.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: この教材、音声付きで分かりやすいです。
lines.en: This material has audio and is easy to follow.
lines.style: attentive adult student voice, soft warm earnest engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 音声を、繰り返し聞くといいですよ。
lines.en: It's good to listen to the audio repeatedly.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 質問したら、返信はもらえますか?
lines.en: If I ask, do I get a reply?
lines.style: curious adult student voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ツールから、すぐ返信が来ますよ。
lines.en: A reply comes quickly from the tool.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 昨日、ツールがダウンしていました。
lines.style: thoughtful adult student voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ダウンは、すぐ直ったようですね。
lines.en: The downtime seems to have been fixed quickly.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 音声の教材、もっと活用したいです。
lines.en: I want to use the audio materials more.
lines.style: motivated adult student voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 良いツールを、賢く使いましょうね。
lines.style: warm teacher voice, soft warm measured closing clarity throughout
